scope: A reviewed, illustrative selection of original general-purpose generative pretraining checkpoints; includes small models and text-capable multimodal bases. Excludes instruction/reasoning-tuned checkpoints, specialist code/science models, community fine-tunes, adapters, conversions, merges, random fixtures, encoder-only and encoder-decoder baselines, and closed APIs. This is not a census or the globally most popular set.
ranking: Exact selected checkpoint repositories sorted by October 31, 2026 snapshot downloads_30d. No aggregation over descendants or model families; unknown stays unranked.
